THE RESIDENCE

Jewel Water Lilly

The fast pace of modern living demands a location that meets many sensible parameters. Jewel Water Lilly is coming up at a much sought after place; Nagambadom-Kottayam. It's a calm, cool and romantic setting beside the Meenachil River. The best of conveniences of Kottayam town are just walking distances from here. Water Lily being the only water front apartment project by the side of Meenachil in Kottayam, is one of Jewel's signature project.
